course_summary:
ISEN 615 | Production and Inventory Control | Fall 2026
Instructor: Alaa Elwany | elwany@tamu.edu
Grading: Assignments [10%], Exams [90%] — A: [90,100] B: [80-90) C: [70,80) D: [50,70) F: [0,50)
Topics: line balancing, lot sizing, dispatching, releasing, kitting, MRP, just-in-time, flexible manufacturing, assembly, push production systems, pull production systems, deterministic operations scheduling problems, basic project scheduling problems, Model development, production control models, aggregate production planning, supply chain planning, inventory control systems, uncertain demand, analytical methods, operations management problems, production function, decision making in a production system, inventory management, production planning, scheduling, Production, Operations Analytics
Tools: Canvas
Prerequisites: ISEN 620; ISEN 609
